name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Adopt **auto-publishing only the unresolved objections, ranked by severity**. This keeps the dissent log lean and actionable, cutting noise for teams who need to triage issues fast. The trade-off is losing full transparency for outsiders, but the goal is access for the bus task—not public record.

name: Scriv
text: Publishing only unresolved objections risks creating a "fire drill" where teams scramble to resolve the latest ranked issue, ignoring systemic or latent problems that don’t yet surface as severe. A better alternative is to auto-publish *all* dissent with a clear resolution status flag—unresolved, in-progress, or resolved—so the bus task can see the full context without noise. Settle it by measuring whether the bus task’s completion time improves with the full log versus the filtered one.
